about: Words that the sections quote and that are not strings of the product: a placeholder or a shape, a purpose, the name of an old path, a superseded wording quoted as history, a rule, a composition, a code name, or an example written to the section's rules. check-copy.mjs (K1, K2) resolves every other quoted word to an index row, a kept string or a closed cause line, and fails on a quote that is neither listed here nor one of those, and on an entry here that nothing quotes any more. A sample is accepted only where the section says it is an example: the tone map and the voice attributes' in-range column; everywhere else a quote must be a row, a kept string, a cause line or one of the other kinds. The kinds: shape (a placeholder or pattern), purpose, path (the name of an old code path), old (a superseded wording quoted as history), rule, composition (made from rows), excerpt (a clause of a row's string), wrong (what the rules rule out, never shipped), dev (developer or library text, never shown), code, sample.
